title: Skill eval (evals/<name>.yaml)
description: One eval: the libraries to test and one or more cases (prompt, fixture, scorers). The eval's name is its file name. Top-level fixture and scorers are defaults that a case inherits unless it sets its own; every case must end up with scorers.

description.description: One line on what is measured; printed above the eval's scores.

libraries.description: Skill libraries (folders in libraries/) to install, one cell per library. The baseline without a library ("none") runs too, unless `baseline` is false; an empty list runs only the baseline.

baseline.description: Whether to also run every case without a library (the "none" cell), for comparison. Set it to false to only run the libraries.

fixture.description: Default fixture for cases without their own.

cases.description: The prompts to test; each runs in every cell (harness x library), n times.

id.description: Unique within the eval; names run folders and the trace tag eval.case.

prompt.description: The single non-interactive prompt the agent gets, run in the workspace.

fixture.description: This case's fixture; replaces the top-level default.

scorers.description: This case's scorers; replace the top-level default.
Default scorers for cases without their own: built-in ones or the project's (see the scorer `name`). The skills_used diagnostic is always added.

name.description: A built-in scorer (skill_invoked, answer_matches) or one from the project's scorers package (its REGISTRY).

args.description: Keyword arguments for the scorer's factory.

min_pass.description: Minimum pass rate (0-1) in every cell with a library; below it, `skill-evals score` exits with 1. Baseline cells (no library) never gate. Without it, --min-pass applies, if given.

skill.description: Skill name without namespace, e.g. "pr" or "code-review".

namespace_required.description: Only count Claude Code Skill-tool loads named "<plugin>:<skill>", so a built-in skill of the same name doesn't count. SKILL.md reads (Codex) always count.

pattern.description: Python regex searched for in the final answer. Use inline flags such as (?ms) and look-aheads to require several sections in any order.

fixture.description: The fixture kit (a folder in the project's fixtures) that builds the workspace inside the sandbox. Without one, the agent starts in an empty workspace.

oneOf.description: The fixture's name, with its default arguments.

args.description: Values for the arguments the kit declares (spec.yaml `args`).
